observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a label on a solar panel with the brand 'SUNTECH' and model 'STP300-24/Rb'.
The label lists technical specifications: 300W rated power, 8.80A current at Pmax, 36.1V voltage at Pmax, monocrystalline cell technology, and 'Made in Japan'.
Photo 1 shows the back of the solar panel with the same label visible, along with a black junction box and two black cables extending from it.
The panel has a white backsheet and a metal frame. The cables appear to be connected to the junction box.
Watermark 'MIKADO SOLAR ENERGY' is visible on both photos, and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is on photo 1.
